extractionContract.logs: JSON records parsed from node-{0..4}.log in each hash-bound raw archive
extractionContract.operations: largest replica_operations SQLite snapshot for svc-movielens-topn
extractionContract.reservations: largest storage_reservations SQLite snapshot for svc-movielens-topn
extractionContract.duplicateMetric: per operation max(0, target CREATE handler invocations - 1); source CREATE dispatches are reported separately
extractionContract.residue: non-terminal runtime operation rows plus runtime reservations not released

durableSnapshots.replicaOperationsSql: SELECT operation_id,type,partition_id,entity_type,entity_id,replica_id,source_node_id,target_node_id,status,workflow_step,created_at,updated_at,completed_at,error_message FROM replica_operations WHERE entity_type='runtime_service' AND entity_id='svc-movielens-topn' ORDER BY created_at;
durableSnapshots.storageReservationsSql: SELECT reservation_id,operation_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at,released_at FROM storage_reservations WHERE entity_type='runtime_service' AND entity_id='svc-movielens-topn' ORDER BY created_at;
